args.article: Today's AI agents landscape is shifting rapidly from experimentation to real-world deployment. Open-source frameworks are tripling production adoption, while startups increasingly replace hand-coded orchestration with model-driven agents. Tool-calling reliability has become the key benchmark for frontier models, and multi-agent swarms are entering regulated enterprise workflows. New observability standards are emerging to trace agent decisions end to end, signaling the field's maturation.
